corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 6th-order cross-bar of ት (ላንት), consistent with lines 26 and 34 in the same column.
The first character at the end of the line clearly shows the left-side hook of 6th-order ብ (ብሎ፡).
The printed text uses the archaic 2nd-order ሁ (ሁነ) with the side stroke on the right leg, not ሆነ.
Both visually (1st-order ነ without a bottom horizontal foot) and grammatically (plural object suffix -ነ parallel to ትስድደነ in line 5, quoting Matt 8:29 by the demons), the word is ትሣቅየነ.
The printed glyph is the archaic Andemta form ሁነች with 2nd-order ሁ.
The printed glyph at the end of the line is the archaic Andemta form ሁነ (2nd-order ሁ) wrapping to ለት on the next line.
Canonical Ge'ez of James 2:23 and the visual glyph show 7th-order ቆ (ወተኰለቆ = ወተኰለቀ + ሎቱ/pronominal suffix -ኦ, translated in line 30 as ተቈጠረለት).
